healthbar.configuration.title: HealthBar Configuration
healthbar.configuration.display.tooltip:
Controls how the health value is displayed.
 - ABSOLUTE: displays the current and max health as absolute values
 - PERCENT: displays the current health as a percentage of max health
healthbar.configuration.threshold.toolti: Controls the threshold above which the vanilla health display is replaced by a health bar
healthbar.configuration.hideNumbersInHar: Controls whether health numbers are hidden in hardcore mode
